text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests, on the other hand, examine how different parts of a system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Although writing tests takes extra time, it gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they know their changes have not broken anything. As a result, teams can improve their software more safely and release new versions without fear.
